## Checklist

- [ ] The folder is `modules/<id>/` and `module.json` has the same `id`.
- [ ] For an update, `version` in `module.json` is higher.
- [ ] I tested it in Loom (Settings › Shell › Module folders → this repository's `modules` folder).
- [ ] It sends no data anywhere, or the description says where and why.
- [ ] It runs no programs and downloads no code, or the description says what and why.
